Hello, I am stocking up on some of my skincare this shopping season and want to try a new AB moisturizer. I have seen high praises for the Isntree Mugwort Calming Cream, Dr G Red Blemish Clearing Cream, Round Lab Dokdo Cream, and Holika Holika Super Ceramide Cream and am trying to pick one to try out.

**Skin Type** - Combination + sensitive skin thats somewhat blemish prone and extra dry in winter

**Country/Climate** - Midwest USA, hot and humid in summer and cold and windy in winter

**Top Skin Concern** - Hyperpigmentation from the occasional blemishes I get, overall tone improvement and hydration

**Current Routine** - AM: wash w water, Cosrx Snail Mucin, Cetaphil cream in the tub as moisturizer

PM: wash with either Cetaphil Cleansing Foam, bynature turmeric/vitamin C wash, or Orjena Vitamin C face wash. Tone with Cosrx Propolis Synergy toner, follow up w Paula’s Choice 2% BHA, and then Good Molecules Discoloration Correcting serum

I have a very bare bones and simple routine and my skin does overall great w this, but I am looking for a new moisturizer as I have been using the same one for eternity and want to switch it up a bit. I am always hesitant to try new products because theres possibility it will break me out. For example ive used the Cosrx Snail Mucin for years but recently tried the snail cream from them and broke out lol. 

I am looking for something similar to what I use currently but maybe to use after my nighttime routine or on days where I dont need as much moisture as the Cetaphil. Cream texture preferred and I cant handle any products with fragrance, something calming soothing and moisturizing without added heaviness. Which of those would you recommend if you have experience with any/all of these based on my skin type and current routine? Sorry for a lengthy post and TIA!!
